The guide's specific rule 3.2 says identical short-footnote calls bind to the first such call, in contrast with 'a <ref> with content is its own definition'; so a later identical {{sfn}} call is a use of the first call's definition, not a definition of its own. render.html confirms one rendered note (cite_note-FOOTNOTEBartholdSourdel19601036-1) with three backlinks _1-0/_1-1/_1-2. The locked file lists the call at cp 1213 as the definition and the call at cp 1562 as a use binding to it (u3). Ambiguity: 3.1 lists 'a short-footnote template call' among definitions; read with 3.1's 'two definitions with the same name and group are one reference' and 3.2's binding rule, the repeat is one reference already labelled.
